# DrawerVariant

`Flare.Components.DrawerVariant`

Display variant for FlareDrawer.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Temporary` | `0` | Slides in over content with a scrim backdrop. Default. |
| `Permanent` | `1` | Always visible alongside content; no scrim, no transform animation. |
| `Persistent` | `2` | Pushes content aside when open; collapses to zero width when closed. |
| `Mini` | `3` | Icon-only width by default; expands to full width on hover. |
| `Responsive` | `4` | Behaves as Persistent on large screens and Temporary on small screens. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDrawer`
- `FlareLayoutDrawer`
